name: webviewTag
description:
### Warning

Electron's `webview` tag is based on Chromium's `webview`, which is undergoing dramatic architectural changes. This impacts the stability of `webviews`, including rendering, navigation, and event routing. We currently recommend to not use the `webview` tag and to consider alternatives

members.name: load-commit
members.desc: Fired when a load has committed. This includes navigation within the current document as well as subframe document-level loads, but does not include asynchronous resource loads.

members.name: did-finish-load
members.desc: Fired when the navigation is done, i.e. the spinner of the tab will stop spinning, and the `onload` event is dispatched.

members.name: did-fail-load
members.desc: This event is like `did-finish-load`, but fired when the load failed or was cancelled, e.g. `window.stop()` is invoked.

members.name: did-frame-finish-load
members.desc: Fired when a frame has done navigation.

members.name: did-start-loading
members.desc: Corresponds to the points in time when the spinner of the tab starts spinning.

members.name: did-stop-loading
members.desc: Corresponds to the points in time when the spinner of the tab stops spinning.

members.name: enter-html-full-screen
members.desc: Fired when page enters fullscreen triggered by HTML API.

members.name: leave-html-full-screen
members.desc: Fired when page leaves fullscreen triggered by HTML API.

members.desc:

This value can only be modified before the first navigation.
